subject: E-Commerce
title: Seller Verification Systems
description: A micro-lesson that makes Seller Verification Systems usable.

hook.text: Amazon requires sellers to submit ID, bank statements, and video interviews. It catches Ks of fake sellers monthly.

buildup.text: Seller verification aims to ensure real businesses with real identities behind every listing on the platform.

discovery.text: Despite verification, sellers create multiple accounts using fake documents.

twist.text: You can buy a pre-verified Amazon seller account for $500 on underground forums.

climax.text: Seller Verification Systems matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: ID, bank, video call—still not enough. Fake seller accounts sell for $500.

quiz.question: Why is seller verification alone insufficient to prevent fraud?
options: Pre-verified accounts can be purchased, and suspended sellers create new identities
